proof_body:
by
  intro ι _ _ m S hS t
  exact ProbabilityTheory.charFun_multivariateGaussian hS t
target_source: ∀ (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (m : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (S : Matrix ι ι ℝ), S.PosSemidef → ∀ t : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι, MeasureTheory.charFun (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian m S) t = Complex.exp ((inner ℝ t m : ℂ) * Complex.I - ((t.ofLp ⬝ᵥ S.mulVec t.ofLp : ℝ) : ℂ) / 2)
